Why Work With Mobilunity

Extensive Talent Pool

Mobilunity can find and hire experienced Android adepts in Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Asia. So you access the global talent pool of candidates with proven track records for your Android project.

Quick Hiring

During 1st week, you receive the first 3 CVs and get your software engineers on board in under 6 weeks. Eventually, we need 3-4 weeks on average to assemble the team of skilled Android developers for your project.

3R Approach

Mobilunity’s goal isn’t only to get you matched with skilled and experienced Android developers. We aim at long-term cooperation backed by our 3R philosophy. It includes high-quality Recruitment, Relationships, and Retention.

Lower Development Cost

With our access to global Android talent, we can hire senior and proven professional engineers in regions with lower costs of living. You can significantly cut the cost to hire and build an Android app without compromising its quality.

Full Back-Office Support

Mobilunity takes all the back-office hassle out of hiring. We sign contracts with engineers, transfer payrolls, and pay taxes and benefits following local employment laws. We also offer a responsive help desk for clients.

Effective Talent Retention

Mobilunity’s retention strategy helps us make sure that your app developers are happy, engaged, and willing to stay with you as long as you need. And we are proud that our client partnerships last for 4.2 years on average.

Reliable Android App Development Services Our Engineers Provide

Dynamic Web Apps

We can find Android experts who are highly skilled in creating web apps that boost your communication with customers. Since users don’t need to download your app to the Android device they own, you improve its accessibility, ensure timely updates, and leverage effortless maintenance.

Android UI/UX

Make your app look trustworthy and brand-aligned with a catchy, aesthetically pleasing, and consistent design. Our skilled and creative mobile engineers help you grow user acquisition and retention and establish strong connections with your target audience.

Android Application Migration

Reach the broad compatibility of your apps across multiple devices by moving them to cross-platform frameworks or later Android versions. Hire Android programmers to improve the responsiveness and performance of your apps and streamline their development.

Native App Development

From FinTech and e-commerce to gaming and IoT — hire our developers to create robust and engaging applications for the Android platform. They create B2B, B2C, and B2E apps of any size and complexity and personalize app experiences.

Cross-Platform Apps

Save your time and costs on your mobile app’s development, using multi-platform frameworks like Xamarin, Flutter, and React Native. Increase your market share and customer satisfaction by offering consistent user experience and using rapid prototyping to test app concepts.

Custom Mobile Applications

Our Android developers use advanced instruments to offer your enterprise users the required features, best practices and seamless experience. They customize your app and tailor its functionality to promote the organizational culture and emphasize the sense of belonging.

Android Advisory

Get advice on the development process, design, architecture, functionality, or audit from Android experts with years of experience in your industry. They’ll help you select the right technology, check compliance issues, plan for integration, and estimate costs for your Android solution.

AI and ML App Development

Incorporate predictive analytics and typing, biometrics and facial recognition, chatbots and virtual assistants, personalized experiences, and other AI- and ML-driven features into your application. With our developers, you unlock efficiency and user engagement.

Testing, Maintenance, and Upgrade

Protect your users’ data and keep their experience smooth with regular updates and maintenance of your application. Mobilunity’s mobile engineers address the vulnerabilities and bugs to maximize your solution’s security.

Multiple APIs Integration

Enrich your Android solution with diverse functionalities without making users wait. Our engineers can effectively handle the asynchronous nature of APIs to keep the smooth execution of several API calls, ensuring the high performance and security of your app.

FAQs on Hiring Top Android Developers

How fast can you contract an Android mobile developer?

The hiring process of an expert Android developer for your business takes 3-4 weeks and 2.5 interviews per candidate on average. However, these timeframes also depend on a client’s prompt feedback, so we typically need around 6 weeks to close a vacancy.

What’s included in Mobilunity’s services?

We cover the back-office support for our Android developers for hire. It includes HR, accounting, and legal services, office rentals, purchases of hardware and software, and IT helpdesk support. Our Account Management and Resource Management teams ensure proactive communication between you and your engineers. They take care that parties meet each other’s expectations.

What technical skills should an Android specialist have?

Knowledge of Android SDK, Java or Kotlin language for Android development, Android Studio, Gradle, React Native, and Flutter frameworks is essential. Your engineers should be proficient in packaging apps for deployment. They should be also familiar with test suites, and implementing standard Android architectures (MVVM, MVP, MVC).

What should I seek in a senior developer?

Skilled developers should be experienced in network debugging with Stetho, mitmproxy, and Charles network proxy tools. They also know diverse libraries and structures like RxAndroid, Volley, and Retrofit. These experts know how to track memory leaks with Android Monitor, Leak Canary, or Memory Analyzer. They reduce overdraw with AVD manager/Layout or Drawing Settings. They debug cached values with SQLiteManager, and Stetho. Of course, you pay more for a senior engineer. But eventually you save significantly by avoiding critical mistakes and achieving goals faster.

Do you offer assistance for technical interviews?

Absolutely. We offer technical interviews as a service to help you check the technical expertise of your potential Android team members. We’ll free your developers from time-consuming and distracting tech interviews. Eventually, you’ll get a detailed report on each candidate.
